provenance.construction: One-qubit Clifford reduction of the board entry codes/512-18-18.json, whose open-boundary weight-8 planar tile construction, bilayer layout, and X/Z witnesses are credited to @MathysRennela. Use source X row 0 as S={0,3,34,48,258,275,288,307} and choose a=0. Clear a from the only other incident X generator by R_169 <- R_169 + S. Apply CNOT fan-out from control 0 to targets {3,34,48,258,275,288,307}; this maps S to X_0 and maps column 0 of H_Z to zero by CSS commutation. Delete X_0 and qubit 0, then renumber every surviving source qubit q>0 as q-1. This is a Clifford equivalence followed by removal of a disentangled qubit, so k remains 18. Surviving qubits keep their source coordinates; maximum check weight remains 8, interaction radius remains 4.242640687119285, and the layout remains bilayer.
provenance.notes: Derivative contribution, not an independent tile construction. The source [[512,18,d<=18]] code, layout, weight-20 X witness, and weight-18 Z witness are credited to @MathysRennela; this contribution is the explicit one-qubit stabilizer reduction to n=511. The current official verifier recomputes k=18, maximum check weight 8, bilayer locality, and interaction radius 4.242640687119285. Two independent CI-style fire passes used seeds 2026101102 and 2027101105. Each pass ran the structural detector, the 50000-trial orbit-fold gate, 86320 ordinary RIS trials, and 8000000 RIS-fast trials. Neither pass found a logical below weight 18; the lightest observed weight was 18 in every ordinary and fast pass. Total post-reduction RIS search: 16172640 trials. Distance remains a witness-backed upper bound, not an exact-distance claim.
